tools.name: nutshell_list_accounts
tools.description: List accounts (companies and organizations) with their owners, types and custom fields. GET /rest/accounts.

tools.name: nutshell_get_account
tools.description: Get one account by its API ID, for example 3-accounts. GET /rest/accounts/{id}.

tools.name: nutshell_list_contacts
tools.description: List contacts (people) with their email, phone, company and custom fields. GET /rest/contacts.

tools.name: nutshell_get_contact
tools.description: Get one contact by its API ID, for example 3-contacts. GET /rest/contacts/{id}.

tools.name: nutshell_list_leads
tools.description: List leads (deals) with their value, status, owner, pipeline stage and confidence. Use filter, for example status or owner. GET /rest/leads.

tools.name: nutshell_get_lead
tools.description: Get one lead by its API ID, for example 1003-leads, with its links to products, contacts and tags. GET /rest/leads/{id}.

tools.name: nutshell_list_lead_outcomes
tools.description: List the outcomes a lead can close with, for example won or lost, with their IDs. Use an ID with nutshell_set_lead_status. GET /rest/outcomes.

tools.name: nutshell_list_pipelines
tools.description: List pipelines (stagesets) in the instance, including archived ones. GET /rest/stagesets.

tools.name: nutshell_list_stages
tools.description: List the active stages of the active pipelines that the authenticated user can see. GET /rest/stages.

tools.name: nutshell_list_sources
tools.description: List the sources that leads can come from, for example a website form or a referral. GET /rest/sources.

tools.name: nutshell_list_tags
tools.description: List tags used to group leads, contacts and accounts. GET /rest/tags.

tools.name: nutshell_list_users
tools.description: List the users of the Nutshell instance, for example to find a lead owner or task assignee. GET /rest/users.

tools.name: nutshell_get_user
tools.description: Get one user by its API ID, for example 1-users. GET /rest/users/{id}.

tools.name: nutshell_list_activities
tools.description: List activities (calls, meetings, emails) between users and contacts. Use filter, for example dateMin or dateMax as Unix timestamps. GET /rest/activities.

tools.name: nutshell_list_tasks
tools.description: List tasks. Use filter, for example assignee, relatedEntity, dateMin or dateMax. GET /rest/tasks.

tools.name: nutshell_list_notes
tools.description: List notes attached to leads, contacts and accounts. GET /rest/notes.

tools.name: nutshell_create_lead
tools.description: Create one lead. The description becomes the lead name. POST /rest/leads.

tools.name: nutshell_create_note
tools.description: Add a note to a lead, contact or account. POST /rest/notes.

tools.name: nutshell_create_task
tools.description: Create a task, optionally linked to an entity and assigned to a user. POST /rest/tasks.

tools.name: nutshell_update_lead
tools.description: Change one lead with a JSON Patch list. Each operation is {"op": "replace"|"add"|"remove", "path": "/leads/0/<field>", "value": ...}. PATCH /rest/leads/{id}.

tools.name: nutshell_set_lead_status
tools.description: Close a lead with an outcome, for example won or lost. Get the outcome IDs from nutshell_list_lead_outcomes. POST /rest/leads/{id}/status.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: nutshell_list_contacts, nutshell_list_activities, nutshell_set_lead_status · Private data: nutshell_list_contacts, nutshell_get_contact, nutshell_get_lead, nutshell_list_tags, nutshell_list_activities, nutshell_list_notes, nutshell_create_note · Public sink: nutshell_list_contacts, nutshell_create_lead, nutshell_create_note, nutshell_create_task, nutshell_set_lead_status · Destructive: nutshell_update_lead.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: nutshell_list_contacts, nutshell_list_activities, nutshell_set_lead_status · Private data: nutshell_list_contacts, nutshell_get_contact, nutshell_get_lead, nutshell_list_tags, nutshell_list_activities, nutshell_list_notes, nutshell_create_note · Public sink: nutshell_list_contacts, nutshell_create_lead, nutshell_create_note, nutshell_create_task, nutshell_set_lead_status · Destructive: nutshell_update_lead

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
